paseo.commit_message:
Start model-less Pi agents on Pi's configured default model (#5343)

A Pi agent created without a model took the first entry of Pi's model
list, which ignores defaultProvider/defaultModel in Pi's settings. The Pi
catalog now marks the model a fresh Pi session reports in get_state as
the default, so the daemon's default-model fallback picks it.

Closes #4918

Co-authored-by: paseo-bot[bot] <266920839+paseo-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

ruflo.release_body:
# RuFlo 3.45.0: upgrades stop leaving a stale memory package behind

**Released 24 September 2026.** Upgrade:

```sh
npx ruflo@latest --version    # should print: ruflo v3.45.0
```

---

## The short version

- **A fix that spans two packages now reaches you together.** `npx @claude-flow/cli@latest` reuses one cache folder across versions, and npm keeps an older `@claude-flow/memory` that still fits the allowed range. So an upgrade could quietly leave you on the old memory package, with nothing reporting a problem. The CLI now asks for one exact memory version, so a stale copy can no longer pass. (#3392)
- **`ruflo doctor` tells you when it happens anyway.** A new check, `@claude-flow/memory version`, compares the memory package the CLI actually loads with the one it asks for. If they differ it warns and prints the command to clear the cache. It is a warning, not a failure, so it never changes doctor's exit code. Try it with `ruflo doctor --component memory-package`.
- **Running the test suite no longer edits your own config.** One test ran the real `init` against your home folder, adding to `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` and `~/.codex/config.toml` and leaving a background download running. It now uses a throwaway home. This is a test-only change. (#3370)

## Checked

With memory `alpha.24` already installed, adding the old `cli@3.44.0` left it at `alpha.24`. Adding the published `cli@3.45.0` upgraded it to `alpha.25`, and the new check reports it satisfied.

## Known gaps

- The `ruflo` wrapper still allows any `@claude-flow/cli` from 3.33.0 up, so `npx ruflo@latest` can still run an older cached CLI (#3306). Use an explicit version when checking.
- The signed witness manifests were regenerated from a source-only checkout. The entries that point at build output are carried forward unchanged, not re-checked, so their "verified" count is not fresh. A regeneration on a fully built tree is the follow-up.
- `@claude-flow/mcp` on npm still ships the old shell-based `github-safe.js` helper (#3411). The fix is in review as #3412 and is not part of this release.

multica.commit_message:
feat: steer a running agent from the normal composer, per recipient (MUL-7631) (#8760)

* feat(server): steer running turns from ordinary comments (MUL-7631)

A comment can now name recipients whose running turn should receive it
(`steer_agent_ids` on POST /issues/:id/comments). Each named recipient
with a running, steer-capable turn gets the comment bound to that turn
instead of a follow-up run; any other recipient keeps its normal
queued / coalesced / deferred trigger, so losing a race never drops input.

- One comment can steer several turns: receipts are keyed by
  (comment_id, task_id) and returned as `supplements` on comments and
  timeline entries. The single supplement_* fields mirror the first
  receipt for older clients.
- Completion reconciliation skips a steered comment only for the agent
  it steered, so the same comment still reaches recipients that were
  addressed without steering.
- Delivery claims match the (comment, run) pair.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Co-authored-by: multica-agent <github@multica.ai>

* feat(issues): choose per recipient how a message reaches a running agent (MUL-7631)

Steering moves from a separate "Add message" box on the run row into the
normal reply and comment composers. Recipients keep the existing trigger
rules; each recipient's current run on the issue decides what the message
can do:

- running (and steer-capable): add to the current run (default in that
  run's own thread), start after this run, stop and start over, or skip
- queued: include when it starts, or skip
- idle: start on send, or skip

Receipts follow the message ("Waiting for Lambda to read it" → "Read by
Lambda · after step N"), a failed delivery offers retry or sending it as
a new run, and the run's step list marks where it read the message.
A draft whose recipient finished meanwhile stays in place and says it
will start a new run; a message with files is handled after the run.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Co-authored-by: multica-agent <github@multica.ai>

* fix(server): steer only the chosen turn, and make a retried steer idempotent (MUL-7631)

- Steering names the exact running turns the author chose
  (`steer_task_ids`). A chosen turn that ended before the send arrives is
  never swapped for a later turn of the same agent; that recipient keeps
  its normal trigger.
- A steering send carries `client_request_id`. A retry after a lost
  response returns the original comment (200) instead of creating a second
  comment and a second delivery; a concurrent twin binding the same request
  is treated as already steered.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Co-authored-by: multica-agent <github@multica.ai>

* fix(issues): guard steering sends against stale previews and broad resends (MUL-7631)

- "Stop and start over" never stops a run while the trigger preview is
  still catching up with an edited @mention: the stop is dropped unless the
  preview answers the sub

orca.release_body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

## The short version

**Agents & chat:** Finished chats collapse to their answers, failed turns end instead of hanging, unread lights up when a structured chat finishes, and restart recovery stays in the status bar. Antigravity can run as a supervised worker, and terminal launches report back the pane they created.

**Terminal, editor & workspaces:** Terminal theme choice overrides Ghostty colors, the Linux daemon survives service restarts and reaps cleanly, and macOS tells you how to fix folder access. Large artifact and conflict lists are virtualized, stale search listings are fixed, and Monaco failures stay contained.

**Remote & reliability:** WSL guests keep the OpenCode agent variant, recreated SSH targets keep their generation floor, and same-cap relay waves clean up failed templates without touching the backend service.

---

## Product experience

### Agents, chat & launches

*Structured chats settle cleanly, launches carry their context, and workspace lists stay responsive.*

* fix(sidebar): stop a workspace with a structured chat reading as asleep by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22098
* Fix stale listings when search query changes by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22173
* Virtualize artifacts list with reusable component by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22061
* Clear website annotations after successful delivery by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22060
* fix(native-chat): stop a subagent's output speaking for the agent that spawned it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21398
* revert: defer subagent attribution until linkage refactor by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22058
* fix(native-chat): collapse a finished turn to its answer by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22029
* fix(native-chat): end a structured turn when the agent reports it failed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22047
* feat(native-chat): light the unread indicators when a structured chat finishes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21924
* fix(native-chat): navigate to open history sessions by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21283
* feat(native-chat): keep restart recovery available in status bar by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21397
* feat(agent-launch): carry the launch inputs the host cannot derive by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22037
* refactor(agent-launch): assemble host startup-plan inputs in one resolver by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22082
* feat(agent-launch): report the pane a terminal launch created by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22108
* refactor(floating-workspace): launch the default agent through the shared launcher by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21390
* feat: support Antigravity as supervised worker by @beattlekid in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21705

### Usage reporting

*Claude usage stays live and cost totals cover the newest models.*

* fix(rate-limits): keep polling Claude usage for Fable accounts during live sessions by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22071
* fix(usage): price GPT-6 Astra, and declare when the Codex cost total omits a model by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22073

### Terminal

*Theme choice wins, background services survive restarts, and latency numbers stay honest.*

* fix(settings): make terminal theme selection override Ghostty colors by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22069
* fix(daemon): escape the terminal daemon into its own systemd scope so a service restart no longer kills every live PTY by @LesleyMurfin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19430
* fix(macos): tell the user when Orca's terminal service can't read their folder, and walk them through the fix by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21923
* fix(daemon): reap terminal descendants during shutdown by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22232
* fix(linux): release orphaned processes when their owner exits by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22247
* fix(perf): measure terminal latency with presented CI frames by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22096
* fix(perf): calibrate report budgets without masking latency stalls by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22075

### Editor, workspaces & source control

*Updates download reliably, large artifact and conflict lists stay fast, and editor failures stay contained.*

* fix(updater): send the gh token and cache the release picker's build list by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21902
* Lower filter chip contrast to indicate read-only status by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21751
* Refactor editor header file rename to breadcrumb morph UI by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21265
* fix(renderer): contain Monaco initialization failures by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21555
* Virtualize large conflict file trees by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21920
* refactor: use generic VirtualizedList in conflict review by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22092
* fix(browser): notify state on offscreen page navigation commit by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21703

### Providers & assistants

*OpenCode launches keep their variant and plugins across hosts.*

* fix(opencode): support v2 plugins under the plain executable name by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22078
* fix(wsl): preserve OpenCode agent variant in guest by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22089

### Remote, SSH & relay

*Recreated targets keep their floor and failed rollouts clean up after themselves.*

* fix(ssh): keep the generation floor when a target is removed and recreated by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22146
* fix(relay): keep the backend service out of the same-cap wave; the capacity role cannot update it by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22140
* fix(relay): let a same-cap cell plan delete the deposed template a failed wave left behind by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22170

### Mobile (OTA page)

*The over-the-air page gains session routing, rich editing, dictation, capability checks, and keyboard and paint polish. Listed here for visibility only; the mobile app ships on its own release schedule.*

* feat(mobile): register the session page route (OTA phase C, C7.7) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21977
* refactor(mobile): the bridge host mount reads one args ref, and the handshake fact lives in the session (OTA phase C, audit item 3) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22080
* fix(mobile): hold every hybrid shell switch on a neutral state while the flag is unresolved (OTA phase C, ruling 33.7) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22077
* feat(mobile): the microphone owns the wake lock, and the stop reply carries the tail (OTA phase C, ruling 36) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22072
* fix(mobile): declare externalLink on the two page routes that reach the protocol wall (OTA phase C follow-up) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22113
* fix(mobile): two more table parsers hold a pipe in a cell (OTA phase C follow-up) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22114

GenericAgent Desktop 桌面版 / Desktop

三个平台产物来自同一提交，并在公开发布前统一验证。All three platform artifacts come from one commit and are validated before publication.

## 安装方法 / Installation
- Windows x64：下载 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`，解压后双击 `GenericAgent.exe`。卸载时运行 `uninstall.bat`，再删除解压目录。
  Windows x64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`, then launch `GenericAgent.exe`. Run `uninstall.bat` before deleting the extracted directory.
- Linux x86_64：下载并解压 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`，执行 `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage` 后运行它。卸载时运行 `uninstall.sh`，再删除解压目录。
  Linux x86_64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`, run `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage`, then launch it. Run `uninstall.sh` before deleting the extracted directory.
- macOS Apple silicon (arm64)：打开 `GenericAgent-Desktop-macOS-aarch64.dmg`，把 `GenericAgent.app` 拖入 Applications。
  macOS Apple silicon (arm64): open `GenericAgent-Desktop-macOS-aarch64.dmg` and drag `GenericAgent.app` to Applications.

## 签名状态 / Signing status
Windows 便携版尚未使用代码签名证书，SmartScreen 可能显示警告；运行前请核对 `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt`。
The Windows portable build is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn; verify `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt` before running it.

macOS 应用仅使用 ad-hoc 签名，未使用 Apple Developer ID，也未 notarize。首次打开可能需要右键选择“打开”或在“隐私与安全性”中允许。
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed only. It is neither Developer ID signed nor notarized; first launch may require Open from the context menu or approval in Privacy & Security.

SHA-256 清单与各产物一同发布。SHA-256 manifests are included with the artifacts.

claude_codex_bridge.release_body:
# v8.7.1

Released: 2026-09-21

## English

### Highlights

- This release includes the previously local `v8.7.0` input protection: human
  drafts delay eligible queued messages for up to 180 seconds, then one clear
  and empty-input confirmation precede delivery. Continued typing does not
  reset that timer. Requests and replies retain one chronological queue per
  agent and wait for the preceding processing turn to end. Recommended initial
  testing is with Claude, Codex and OMP; other input guards will follow.
- Click a local file or press Enter in the Rich file browser to open it with
  the system default application. Click or Enter on a directory navigates
  inside Yazi. Safe and rich profiles share the behavior; mouse opening targets
  the clicked file rather than a previous hover or unrelated selection.
- macOS uses `open`. Linux prefers `gio open`, falling back to `xdg-open` only
  when GIO is absent. WSL detects its kernel or session environment and uses
  `wslview` from `wslu` to open files through Windows associations, including
  mounted-drive and distribution paths. Missing `wslview` produces an error;
  it does not silently fall back to a Linux GUI. WSL interop must be enabled.
- Filenames containing spaces, quotes and shell punctuation remain individual
  arguments. Multiple selected files are supported. Opener failures are not
  automatically retried through a different application.

### Upgrade and validation

- After upgrading CCB, run `ccb update rich`, then reopen the file-browser pane.
  No Agent restart is required for this file-browser change. Generation updates
  CCB-owned profiles only, leaving user Yazi settings and system associations intact.
- To load the input guard and new OMP extension, finish active tasks, save
  drafts, then stop the project with `ccb kill` and restart it with `ccb`.
- Linux native Yazi 26.5.6 mouse/Enter and directory navigation tests passed in
  disposable tmux servers with recording desktop openers. macOS and WSL command
  routing, arguments and failure handling were tested with platform stubs; real
  macOS/WSL GUI launches were not tested. An accepted OS launch request alone
  does not prove a desktop window rendered. SSH does not open on the client PC.
- Version checks now require all README badges, newest embedded release entries and current APK download links
  to match `VERSION`, with a bilingual notes file for that version.

### Known limitations

- The input guard is a first version for testing. Codex/Claude use `Ctrl-C`
  for deadline clearing, so concurrent human actions can still be interrupted;
  capture, clear, paste and Enter are not atomic. Drafts are not backed up.
  Unknown/busy/modal input waits without clearing. OMP requires the new
  extension and default Status Band layout; unsupported paths remain unprotected.
- Ambiguous-send terminalization and OMP bridge production review remain open.
  Forced-daemon-stop Codex remote-session recovery remains manual: inspect
  `ccb screen <agent>` and `ccb trace <job_id>` before cancelling a never-sent
  queued task, restarting the agent and resubmitting it. No automatic recovery
  or universally interruption-free input is claimed.

## 中文

### 版本亮点

- 本版包含此前仅本地提交的 `v8.7.0` 输入保护：用户草稿会让已满足投递条件
  的队首消息最多等待 180 秒，到期清空一次并确认输入为空后投递。继续键入
  不重置计时。请求与返回继续共用每个 Agent 的时间顺序队列，等待前一消息
  的处理回合结束。推荐先在 Claude、Codex、OMP 测试，其他输入保护后续适配。
- 在 Rich 文件面板中点击本地文件或按 Enter，使用系统默认应用打开。
  点击目录或在目录上按 Enter，仍在 Yazi 内导航。safe 和 rich 配置行为一致，
  鼠标打开的是点击的文件，不会误用之前悬停或其他选中的文件。
- macOS 使用 `open`；Linux 优先使用 `gio open`，没有 GIO 时才用
  `xdg-open`。WSL 根据内核或会话环境识别，通过 `wslu` 的 `wslview`
  使用 Windows 文件关联打开，路径包括挂载盘和发行版内文件。缺少
  `wslview` 时明确报错，不静默退回 Linux GUI；必须启用 WSL 互操作。
- 文件名中的空格、引号、Shell 特殊字符保持为完整参数，支持多选文件。
  打开失败时不会自动换用另一个应用重试。

### 升级与验证

- 升级 CCB 后运行 `ccb update rich`，再重新打开文件面板。本次文件面板
  修改无需重启 Agent。生成器只更新 CCB 自有配置，不改个人 Yazi 设置或
  系统文件关联。
- 要加载输入保护和新版 OMP 扩展，请先完成当前任务、保存草稿，再用
  `ccb kill` 停止项目，用 `ccb` 重新启动。
- 已在独立 tmux 中用真实 Linux Yazi 26.5.6 验证鼠标、Enter 和目录导航，
  桌面打开工具用记录程序替代。macOS、WSL 的命令选择、参数和失败处理
  已用平台桩验证，未在真实 macOS/WSL 桌面验证。系统接受打开请求不等于
  已确认窗口显示；SSH 不会把文件打开到客户端电脑。
- 新增检查要求各语言 README 徽章、最新内嵌版本记录、当前 APK 下载链接与 `VERSION`
  一致，并存在对应版本的中英文说明。

### 已知限制

- 输入保护是首版测试功能。Codex/Claude 到期使用 `Ctrl-C` 清空，同时发生
  的人工操作仍可能被中断；抓屏、清空、粘贴、Enter 非原子操作，不备份草稿。
  输入未知、忙碌或弹窗状态会等待而不清空。OMP 要求新版扩展和默认 Status
  Band 布局；未支持的路径仍没有输入保护。
- 发送不明终局处理及 OMP 桥接的生产审查仍未关闭。强制停止 daemon 后
  Codex 远程会话仍需人工恢复：先用 `ccb screen <agent>` 和
  `ccb trace <job_id>` 检查，再取消尚未发送的排队任务、重启 Agent 并
  重新提交。不宣称能够自动恢复或在所有情况下都不打断人工输入。

trellis.changelog_body:
> ## Documentation Index
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.trytrellis.app/llms.txt
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

# v0.6.17

> 2026-09-12

Devin CLI 会话记忆、按需读取 SQLite 页，以及任务/会话绑定修复。

## 功能增强

### Devin CLI 会话适配器

`trellis mem` 通过现有的零依赖解析器读取 Cognition Devin CLI 会话，数据在 `~/.local/share/devin/cli/sessions.db`（WAL SQLite）。这不是 `trellis init --devin`（Desktop/Cascade），也不是 Factory Droid。（#614）

* `list` / `search` / `extract` / `context` / `projects` 支持 `--platform devin`
* OpenCode、ZCode 与 Devin 共用 `packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-adapter.ts` 和 `packages/core/src/mem/platforms.ts`
* Devin 会话树要求 `main_chain_id`；缺少 tip 时返回 `devin-main-chain-missing`（不再回退到 `max(node_id)`）
* 解析前去掉 `CREATE TABLE` 的 `--` 行注释，这样 live `sessions.db` 里的 `parent_node_id` 和 `chat_message` 能被识别

## 问题修复

### SQLite 主文件页懒读

`packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-readonly.ts` 里的零依赖 SQLite 读取器按需加载主文件页，不再把整个数据库读进内存。（#596）

### Pi 无头子代理提示

Pi `trellis_subagent` 把 ask-policy 提示转发到父会话。serving heartbeat 设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_PARENT_SESSION`（不用过期的 `PI_SESSION_ID`），设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_CHILD=1`，并丢掉继承来的 `PI_SESSION_ID`，让子进程自己签发会话 id。（#611）

### 活动任务会话回退

当前会话 id 缺失时，不再回退到项目里仅有的那条会话去解析活动任务。该回退改为显式 opt-in，避免一个会话绑到另一个会话的任务。（#608）

### archive 子任务 unlink 回滚

如果 `task.py archive` 在已经 unlink 部分子任务之后失败，会按清除前的快照把每个子任务的 `parent` 写回去。`children` 里的重复条目只快照一次，避免第二次访问把 `parent: null` 写回去。（#613）

## 升级

```bash theme={null}
npm install -g @mindfoldhq/trellis@latest
trellis update
```

无需 `--migrate`。
